\caption{The 90 verified bilevel feasible points for open MIPLIB-derived instances, for which BOBILib lists no point. $^{\ddagger}$: a point had been published elsewhere (its value and source are in the notes of \texttt{instances.csv}); for the other 80 this is the first point known. Coupling: whether leader rows contain follower variables. Method: \texttt{hpr-f-t}, the high point relaxation, then the follower solved with the leader fixed, then an optimistic tie-break (\texttt{bobi general}); \texttt{hpr}, \texttt{penalty}, \texttt{follow}: the part of the \texttt{bobi coupled} portfolio that found the point (the HPR's own leader values, a penalised HPR, best-response dynamics). Values rounded to four decimals (full precision in \texttt{instances.csv}); the leader minimises, so does the follower. $^{*}$: the follower's value is about $10^{-7}$ relative above its optimum, inside BOBILib's tolerance of $10^{-4}$, so the file is a benchmark-accepted point (class (iii) of Section~\ref{app:classes}); the mark is set from \texttt{general-coupled/summary.csv}, and \texttt{general/points.csv} records no follower error, so points without coupling rows are not marked (Section~\ref{app:general} lists those that are class (iii) too). Three further points are optimal (Table~\ref{tab:hpr}).}\label{tab:general-points}\\
